name: Stormwind Stockade (Classic)
label: Place
description: Prisoners now control the Stormwind Stockade beneath Stormwind City's canal district. A revolt has driven the guards from its halls.
intro: Prisoners now control the Stormwind Stockade beneath Stormwind City's canal district. A revolt has driven the guards from its halls.

p: The Stockade lies off the canals between Old Town and the Mage Quarter, holding Stormwind's most dangerous prisoners. Warden Thelwater oversees the underground prison. Its inmates include Defias Brotherhood cutthroats, a Blackrock orc, an ogre, and a Dark Iron dwarf. Bazil Thredd recently led a coordinated riot that overwhelmed the garrison. The surviving guards fled, leaving the prisoners in control of the halls.
